fsis.field_title: Prairie Table Foods Recalls Ready-To-Eat Chicken Salad Products Due To Possible Salmonella Contamination
fsis.field_product_items: • 12-oz. plastic tubs containing "PRAIRIE TABLE CHICKEN SALAD WITH CUCUMBER" with use by dates 8/20/26 through 8/28/26 and UPC 0 34567 89012 5.
fsis.field_summary: Prairie Table Foods, an Elgin, Ill. establishment, is recalling approximately 9,200 pounds of ready-to-eat chicken salad products that may be contaminated with Salmonella. The cucumbers used in the product are subject to a recall by the supplier. FSIS is concerned that some product may be in consumers' refrigerators. Consumers who have purchased these products are urged not to consume them. These products should be thrown away or returned to the place of purchase.

fsis.field_title: Hollow Creek Meats Recalls Liverwurst Products Due To Possible Listeria Contamination
fsis.field_product_items:
• 1-lb. rolls of "HOLLOW CREEK LIVERWURST" with sell by dates 9/02/26 through 9/16/26.
  • Deli-sliced liverwurst sold at deli counters through 8/17/26.
fsis.field_summary: Hollow Creek Meats is recalling approximately 71,000 pounds of liverwurst products that may be adulterated with Listeria monocytogenes. Consumers who have purchased these products are urged not to consume them and to throw them away or return them to the place of purchase. Consumers should also clean their refrigerators and any surfaces that came into contact with the product.

fsis.field_title: Kettle & Bone Recalls Ground Beef Due To Possible E. coli O157:H7 Contamination
fsis.field_product_items: • 1-lb. vacuum packs of "KETTLE & BONE 80/20 GROUND BEEF" with lot code 0812 and use by 08/28/2026.
fsis.field_summary: Kettle & Bone Co. is recalling approximately 4,000 pounds of ground beef that may be contaminated with E. coli O157:H7. Consumers who have purchased these products are urged not to consume them. These products should be thrown away or returned to the place of purchase.

rss.title: Riverbend Fresh Foods Voluntarily Recalls Baby Spinach and Spring Mix Because of Possible Health Risk
rss.description: Riverbend Fresh Foods, Inc. of Modesto, CA is recalling Baby Spinach and Spring Mix clamshells because they have the potential to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. Consumers who have purchased the product are urged to return it to the place of purchase for a full refund.

rss.title: Pinecone Nut Company Recalls Roasted Almonds Due to Undeclared Peanuts
rss.description: Pinecone Nut Company of Fresno, CA is recalling 8 oz bags of Roasted Almonds, UPC 0 55555 22222 3, because they may contain undeclared peanuts. Consumers who are allergic to peanuts should not eat the product and may return it for a refund. Product was distributed in California, Arizona, and Nevada.
